cases.name: a typed imported builder retains its callable value

modules.main: import {build} from "dep"; type V = build(uint8); if (V !== uint8) throw new Error("wrong type");
modules.dep: export function build(T: type): type { return T; }

cases.name: a cyclic function declaration is available without its module body

modules.main: import "dep"; export function build(T: type): type { return T; }
modules.dep: import {build} from "main"; type V=build(uint8); if(V!==uint8) throw new Error("wrong type");

cases.name: a namespace preserves the actual builder and its type result

modules.main: import * as ns from "dep"; type V = ns.build(uint8); if (V !== uint8) throw new Error("wrong type");
modules.dep: export function build(T: type): type { return T; }

cases.name: a cyclic namespace resolves an initialized function declaration

modules.main: import "dep"; export function build(T: type): type { return T; }
modules.dep: import * as ns from "main"; type V=ns.build(uint8); if(V!==uint8) throw new Error("wrong type");

cases.name: renamed re-exports preserve function identity and resolution

modules.main: import {renamed as build} from "facade"; type V = build(uint8); if (V !== uint8) throw new Error("wrong type");
modules.dep: export function build(T: type): type { return T; }

cases.name: a default-imported builder remains callable

modules.main: import build from "dep"; type V = build(uint8); if (V !== uint8) throw new Error("wrong type");
modules.dep: export default function build(T: type): type { return T; }

cases.name: an untyped imported builder still yields a Type Object

modules.main: import {build} from "dep"; type V = build(uint8); if (V !== uint8) throw new Error("wrong type");
modules.dep: export function build(T) { return T; }

cases.name: an imported arrow builder retains its lexical function value

modules.main: import {build} from "dep"; type V = build(uint8); if (V !== uint8) throw new Error("wrong type");
modules.dep: export const build = (T: type): type => T;

cases.name: an asynchronous dependency completes before an imported builder check

modules.main: import {build} from "dep"; type V = build(uint8); if (V !== uint8) throw new Error("wrong type");
modules.dep: export function build(T: type): type { return T; } await 0;

cases.name: a generic imported builder binds its declared type parameter

modules.main: import {build} from "dep"; type V = build(uint8); if (V !== uint8) throw new Error("wrong type");
modules.dep: export function build<T: type>(value: T): T { return value; }

cases.name: a generic annotation using an imported builder evaluates at specialization

modules.main: import {build} from "dep"; function f<T: type>(x: T): build(T) { return x; } const x: uint8=f.<uint8>(1); if(String(x)!=="1") throw new Error("wrong value");
modules.dep: export function build(T: type): type { return T; }

cases.name: the importer cannot replace a builder capture with a same-spelled constant

modules.main: import {build} from "dep"; const T=string; type V=build(); if(V!==uint8) throw new Error("wrong capture");
modules.dep: const T=uint8; export function build(): type {return T;}

cases.name: a helper retains its defining module environment

modules.main: import {build} from "dep"; const T=string; type V=build(); if(V!==uint8) throw new Error("wrong capture");
modules.dep: const T=uint8; function helper(): type {return T;} export function build(): type {return helper();}

cases.name: an imported Type Object is passed as its value

modules.main: import {build,T} from "dep"; type V=build(T); if(V!==uint8) throw new Error("wrong argument");
modules.dep: export function build(T: type): type { return T; } export type T=uint8;

cases.name: an imported scalar is passed as its value

modules.main: import {build,n} from "dep"; type V=build(n); if(V!==uint8) throw new Error("wrong argument");
modules.dep: export const n=1; export function build(n: number): type {if(n===1) return uint8; return string;}

cases.name: an imported function Type Object remains distinct from a function value

modules.main: import {build,Fn} from "dep"; type V=build(Fn); if(V!==Fn) throw new Error("wrong type");
modules.dep: export function build(T: type): type { return T; } export type Fn=(T: type)=>type;

cases.name: a nested local builder shadow does not change an imported builder

modules.main: import {build} from "dep"; function unused(){function build(): type {return string;} type V=build(); if(V!==string) throw new Error("wrong local");} type V=build(uint8); if(V!==uint8) throw new Error("wrong import"); unused();
modules.dep: export function build(T: type): type { return T; }

cases.name: a builder may create and mutate its own local state

modules.main: import {build} from "dep"; type V=build(); if(V!==uint8) throw new Error("wrong type");
modules.dep: export function build(): type {let T=string; T=uint8; return T;}

cases.name: an immutable capture may itself be imported

modules.main: import {build} from "dep"; type V=build(); if(V!==uint8) throw new Error("wrong type");
modules.dep: import {T} from "leaf"; export function build(): type {return T;}

cases.name: an immutable namespace capture remains admitted

modules.main: import {build} from "dep"; type V=build();
modules.dep: import * as ns from "leaf"; export function build(): type {return ns.T;}

cases.name: a failed imported argument contract rejects before importer entry

modules.main: import {build} from "dep"; type V=build(1);
modules.dep: export function build(T: type): type { return T; }

cases.name: a failed imported return contract rejects before importer entry

modules.main: import {build} from "dep"; type V=build(1);
modules.dep: export function build(T: any): type {return T;}

cases.name: an imported builder must return a Type Object even without a return contract

modules.main: import {build} from "dep"; type V=build(1);
modules.dep: export function build(T: any): any {return T;}

cases.name: an uncalled nested closed annotation still checks an imported builder

modules.main: import {build} from "dep"; function unused(x: build(1)) {}
modules.dep: export function build(T: type): type { return T; }

cases.name: a captured mutable binding is not made constant by importing its builder

modules.main: import {build} from "dep"; type V=build();
modules.dep: let T=uint8; export function build(): type {return T;}

cases.name: a mutable capture through a local helper is rejected

modules.main: import {build} from "dep"; type V=build();
modules.dep: let T=uint8; function helper(): type {return T;} export function build(): type {return helper();}

cases.name: an immutable import of an exported let remains mutable state

modules.main: import {build} from "dep"; type V=build();
modules.dep: import {T} from "leaf"; export function build(): type {return T;}

cases.name: a re-export cannot hide a mutable capture

modules.main: import {build} from "dep"; type V=build();
modules.dep: import {T} from "facade"; export function build(): type {return T;}

cases.name: a namespace member does not freeze an exported mutable value

modules.main: import {build} from "dep"; type V=build();
modules.dep: import * as ns from "leaf"; export function build(): type {return ns.T;}

cases.name: an imported helper cannot hide a mutable capture

modules.main: import {build} from "dep"; type V=build();
modules.dep: import {helper} from "leaf"; export function build(): type {return helper();}
modules.leaf: let T=uint8; export function helper(): type {return T;}

cases.name: a namespace helper cannot hide a mutable capture

modules.main: import {build} from "dep"; type V=build();
modules.dep: import * as ns from "leaf"; export function build(): type {return ns.helper();}
modules.leaf: let T=uint8; export function helper(): type {return T;}

cases.name: a reassigned helper is not a stable function declaration

modules.main: import {build} from "dep"; type V=build();
modules.dep: function helper(): type {return uint8;} helper=()=>string; export function build(): type {return helper();}

cases.name: a reassigned exported builder is rejected through a namespace

modules.main: import * as ns from "dep"; type V=ns.build();
modules.dep: export function build(): type {return uint8;} build=()=>string;

cases.name: a same-spelled assignment in an unrelated function does not reassign a helper

modules.main: import {build} from "dep"; type V=build(); if(V!==uint8) throw new Error("wrong type");
modules.dep: function helper(): type {return uint8;} function unused(){let helper=1; helper=2;} export function build(): type {return helper();}

cases.name: a cyclic imported builder cannot read an uninitialized captured constant

modules.main: import "dep"; const T=uint8; export function build(): type {return T;}
modules.dep: import {build} from "main"; type V=build();

cases.name: an imported throwing builder rejects its type computation

modules.main: import {build} from "dep"; type V=build();
modules.dep: export function build(): type {throw new Error("no type");}

cases.name: an imported builder naming ambient state remains rejected

modules.main: import {build} from "dep"; type V=build();
modules.dep: export function build(): type {globalThis.changed=1; return uint8;}
